meta.title: Surrogate bid with price 95.75
gaps: Adding a reference to the surrogate bid because place_surrogate_bid has no reference argument or assertion.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Adding a reference to the surrogate bid because place_surrogate_bid has no reference argument or assertion.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Participants tab.
Enter and save the buyer's surrogate bid at the requested decimal price.
Assert that Procol accepted the surrogate bid.
Open the comparison grid to verify the submitted price and totals.
Assert that the bid rate is displayed as 95.75.
Assert that line amounts and the sum total are calculated from the submitted rate and quantity.
